metadata.data_notice: Passages and XBRL facts come from each issuer's Form 10-K as retrieved from SEC EDGAR; the accession number, URL and SHA-256 of every source document are in the dataset. Scenario presets, book groupings, labels, statuses and notes are annotations, and values marked as derived are computed from the quoted figures. Not investment advice.
metadata.description: 20 issuers, 4 books, 4 scenario presets and 12 disclosed links, built by scripts/build_sample_book.py. excerpt_sha256 is the SHA-256 of an issuer's bundled passages (fsi_engine.compute_excerpt_sha256); filing.document_sha256 is the SHA-256 of the primary document as retrieved.

retrieval.source: SEC EDGAR: sec.gov Archives, data.sec.gov submissions and XBRL companyfacts
retrieval.normalisation: Filing HTML is reduced to text by removing tags, scripts, styles and the inline-XBRL header, decoding character references, and collapsing each run of whitespace to one space. A sentence passage is an exact substring of that text. A table-row passage is the row's non-empty cell texts joined with ' | '; a currency symbol, closing parenthesis or percent sign that the filing puts in its own cell is attached to the adjacent number.
retrieval.fuel_screen: Oil status 'none_found' means no sentence of the filing text matched all of: a fuel term (fuel, crude, oil, petroleum, gasoline, diesel); a dollar amount; would, could or hypothetical; price, cost, per gallon or per barrel; and increase, decrease or change. It does not mean the filing never mentions fuel.
retrieval.annotations: Book groupings, scenario presets, sector labels, relationship labels, disclosure statuses and the notes attached to them are annotations by the skill authors, not filing content.

supply_chain_edges.share_note: The filing names the engine manufacturer and discloses no revenue share.

supply_chain_edges.share_note: Share of Clorox's fiscal 2026 consolidated net sales that went to Walmart and its affiliates.
supply_chain_edges.verbatim_quote: Net sales to the Company’s largest customer, Walmart Stores, Inc. and its affiliates, were 26%, 27% and 25% of consolidated net sales for each of the fiscal years ended June 30, 2026, 2025 and 2024, respectively, and occurred across all of the Company’s reportable segments.

supply_chain_edges.share_note: Approximate share of P&G's fiscal 2026 total sales that went to Walmart and its affiliates.
supply_chain_edges.verbatim_quote: Sales to Walmart Inc. and its affiliates represent approximately 16% of our total sales in 2026, 2025 and 2024.

supply_chain_edges.share_note: Approximate aggregate share of Qorvo's fiscal 2026 total revenue from end customer Apple Inc. through contract manufacturers.
supply_chain_edges.verbatim_quote: The Company provides products to its largest end customer, Apple Inc., through sales to multiple contract manufacturers, which in the aggregate accounted for approximately 50%, 47% and 46% of total revenue in fiscal years 2026, 2025 and 2024, respectively.

supply_chain_edges.share_note: Aggregate share of Skyworks' fiscal 2026 net revenue from Apple through distributors and contract manufacturers.
supply_chain_edges.verbatim_quote: During fiscal 2026, fiscal 2025, and fiscal 2024, Apple, through sales to multiple distributors and contract manufacturers for multiple applications including smartphones, tablets, desktop and notebook computers, watches, and other devices, in the aggregate accounted for 61%, 67%, and 69% of the Company’s net revenue, respectively.

supply_chain_edges.verbatim_quote: We also announced a strategic partnership with NVIDIA to co-develop custom client and data center products combining our x86 CPU technologies with NVIDIA's AI and accelerated computing capabilities.

supply_chain_edges.share_note: The filing names NVIDIA among the processor vendors Supermicro collaborates with on product cycles and discloses no revenue share.
supply_chain_edges.verbatim_quote: We work closely with NVIDIA, Intel and AMD, among others, to develop products that are compatible with the latest generation of industry-standard technologies under development.
